title: Grab Your Favorite Thing
trend: TikTok 'Pick Your Favorite Thing' couple challenge (couple stands behind a table of items and both grab their favorite thing on three; Virlo current TikTok trends, rising, US) + Sunday football and the run-up to Thanksgiving pie season — Dana and Marcus do the challenge live for the family: round one he grabs the TV remote, round two she grabs the pumpkin pie, Pickles the dog keeps putting himself on the table; twist: final round Marcus sets a ring box, Dana grabs it and it is empty because Pickles hid the ring on his tail so someone would finally grab him; she says yes and the dog becomes ring bearer
length_reason: Pick-your-favorite-thing challenge clips are quick one-clip videos, so this stays a quick one-clip skit: 3:00.
youtube_title: On Three, Grab Your Favorite Thing (He Grabbed The Remote) | Funny Couple Cartoon
description:
Dana and Marcus stand behind a table and promise to grab each other on three. Then there is a remote, a pumpkin pie and a dog who refuses to be ignored, and the last round has a little box on it.

#cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #couples
tiktok_caption: on three, grab your favorite thing. he grabbed the remote 📺 #cartoon #animation #funny #comedy #couples

lines.text: Recording. Okay. Couple challenge. On three, you both grab your favorite thing on the table.
Easy. Everybody knows the answer is supposed to be your partner.
Babe. I know the rules. I have seen these videos.
For the record, I am also on the table. Lying here. Being adorable.
Round one. On the table: a slice of pie, the TV remote, a heated blanket, and Marcus.
Why is Marcus on the table?
I am leaning on the table. It counts.
One. Two. Three.
Got you, baby!
Got the remote!
You grabbed the remote.
It is fourth quarter. I panicked.
Nobody grabbed me. I want that noted in the video.
Comments are already coming in. Your aunt Bev says, oh no, Marcus.
Aunt Bev is watching this?
Everyone is watching this. I went live.
Round two. Remove the remote. Hide it somewhere he cannot reach.
That is fair. That is very fair.
Round two. On the table: the pie, the heated blanket, Pickles, and Marcus.
Finally. My moment.
Marcus, look at me. You are grabbing me. Say it.
I am grabbing you. I promise.
One. Two. Three.
Got you!
Got the pie!
Dana!
It is pumpkin. It is November. I am only human.
I trained for this. I stretched.
I would like to file a complaint. I was right next to the pie.
Aunt Bev says, oh no, Dana. Grandpa says, put the dog in it.
Grandpa gets it. Grandpa has always gotten it.
Okay. Tie game. One to one. Final round decides who loves who more.
Final round. I set the table this time. Close your eyes.
If there is a remote on that table, I am moving back in with my mom.
No remote. Just one little box. And me.
And me. I put myself back on the table. Nobody asked me to.
Small velvet box. Wait. Marcus. Is that what I think it is?
Shh. Stay focused. You are a camera.
I am shaking. My battery just went up by ten percent.
Open your eyes? Okay. What is that box?
On three, grab your favorite thing.
One. Two. Three!
I grabbed the box! I grabbed the box! Is this what I think it is?
I grabbed you. I always grab you. Open it.
It is empty.
It is what?
Aunt Bev says, oh no, everyone.
There was a ring in there. I checked it four times this morning.
Pickles. Look at me.
I would never.
Pickles. Why is your tail sparkling?
Fine. I took it. You always grab the pie and the remote. I wanted to be grabbed for once.
So the ring is on the dog.
It is on my tail. It looks better on my tail.
Then I guess I am grabbing my favorite thing.
Me?
The dog. The ring is on the dog. But yes. Also you. Yes!
She said yes!
Aunt Bev says, finally. Grandpa says, told you, put the dog in it.
Best day of my life. I was grabbed. And I am the ring bearer now. I did not apply.
Can I have the remote back now?
Marcus.
